snippet.title: MORTAROT — Official Trailer | Card Roguelike Against Death
snippet.description:
MORTAROT — a card roguelike where you sit down to play cards against Death, with your own life at stake. Draw cards, take what's yours, or tempt fate once more. 🖤🃏

Death waits at the card table — and invites you to play. Her spread promises riches to fools and hope to the desperate, but the price of a mistake is the same for all.

Draw from her spread, one card at a time: blank, coin, candle — you live. The Death card or your last candle snuffed out — the run is over. At any moment, take what's yours and go one circle deeper — or tempt fate once more. Pass twelve circles and walk away from the table alive.

⚰️ What waits for you at this table:
▸ Greed against fear — every draw costs more than the last
▸ Twenty-two Major Arcana that reshape the rules of the run
▸ Amulets and relics earned along the way
▸ Death sits across the table, wearily mocking, waiting for you to slip
▸ Hand-drawn engraving art, and a twist you'll only grasp at the very end

🎮 Coming soon to Steam.

#MORTAROT #roguelike #cardgame #indiegame #tarot #deathgame #indiedev #darkfantasy #pushyourluck
